lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the dark grey torso; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, narrowing slightly toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the second and third lines from the posterior, which appear to merge or converge near the dorsal ridge; a minor split is also visible on the fifth line from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the mid-torso region terminate abruptly approximately 70% of the way down the torso mass before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 to 7 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, located superior to the hock joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A group of three spots on the lateral surface of the upper hind limb aligns horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric row.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a complex lyrate spiral; projecting outward and upward from the skull, curving inward mid-shaft, and twisting outward at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 to 2.0 times the pixel width across the exterior of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned tips comprise approximately 12-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes, white facial spots on the mandible, and a distinct long, dark ventral fringe extending from the lower neck to the abdomen.
